about.description:
Moonshine lets you stream games from a Linux PC to any device running
Moonlight. Each stream runs in its own isolated compositor, separate
from the desktop environment, so no monitor or active desktop session
is required. It supports hardware H.264/H.265/AV1 encoding via Vulkan,
HDR, surround-sound audio, and full mouse, keyboard, and gamepad input.

The package also ships the Moonshine Vulkan WSI layer
(share/vulkan/implicit_layer.d) and a moonshine-steamos-setup helper for
installing the systemd, udev, modules-load, sysusers, Vulkan, polkit, and
atomic-update integration files needed on SteamOS.

Install and configure it with:

  pixi global install moonshine
  moonshine-steamos-setup

Remove the privileged integration before uninstalling the Pixi environment:

  moonshine-steamos-setup --uninstall
  pixi global uninstall moonshine
about.summary: Headless streaming server for Moonlight clients, written in Rust

script.content:
export LIBCLANG_PATH=${BUILD_PREFIX}/lib
# bindgen needs clang's builtin headers (stdbool.h etc.)
export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="-resource-dir=$(${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/clang -print-resource-dir)"
cargo auditable build --release --locked -p moonshine -p moonshine-wsi
RELEASE_DIR="target/${CARGO_BUILD_TARGET:+${CARGO_BUILD_TARGET}/}release"
install -Dm755 ${RELEASE_DIR}/moonshine ${PREFIX}/bin/moonshine
install -Dm755 ${RELEASE_DIR}/libmoonshine_wsi.so ${PREFIX}/lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so
# The Vulkan loader resolves relative library_path entries relative to the manifest location
sed 's|/usr/lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so|../../../lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so|' \
  dist/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json > VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json
install -Dm644 VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json ${PREFIX}/share/vulkan/implicit_layer.d/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json
install -Dm755 "${RECIPE_DIR}/moonshine-steamos-setup.sh" ${PREFIX}/bin/moonshine-steamos-setup
install -Dm755 dist/start-moonshine.sh ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/start-moonshine.sh
install -Dm644 dist/moonshine@.service ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/moonshine@.service
install -Dm644 dist/60-moonshine.rules ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/60-moonshine.rules
install -Dm644 dist/moonshine-modules.conf ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/moonshine-modules.conf
install -Dm644 dist/moonshine-sysusers.conf ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/moonshine-sysusers.conf
install -Dm644 dist/50-moonshine-inhibit-sleep.rules ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/50-moonshine-inhibit-sleep.rules
install -Dm644 dist/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json
install -Dm644 "${RECIPE_DIR}/moonshine-atomic-update.conf" ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/moonshine-atomic-update.conf
cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output ./THIRDPARTY.yml

tests.script:
moonshine --help
moonshine-steamos-setup --help
if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
  dry_run_output=$(moonshine-steamos-setup --dry-run --no-enable --no-start --no-linger)
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Prefix: ${CONDA_PREFIX}"
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Wrapper: /opt/moonshine-pixi/start-moonshine.sh"
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Moonshine binary: ${CONDA_PREFIX}/bin/moonshine"
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "WSI library: ${CONDA_PREFIX}/lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so"
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Vulkan manifest: /etc/vulkan/implicit_layer.d/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json"
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Templates: validated and rendered successfully"
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Enable service: false"
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Start service: false"
  printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "sudo was not invoked"
  uninstall_output=$(moonshine-steamos-setup --uninstall --dry-run)
  printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "Stop and disable: moonshine@$(id -un).service"
  printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "Preserve Pixi/Conda prefix: ${CONDA_PREFIX}"
  printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "Preserve standalone installation: /opt/moonshine"
  printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "Lingering: unchanged"
  printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "sudo was not invoked"
  if env -u CONDA_PREFIX moonshine-steamos-setup --dry-run --no-enable --no-start --no-linger; then
    echo "setup unexpectedly accepted a missing CONDA_PREFIX" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  empty_prefix=$(mktemp -d)
  if CONDA_PREFIX="$empty_prefix" moonshine-steamos-setup --dry-run --no-enable --no-start --no-linger; then
    echo "setup unexpectedly accepted a prefix with missing assets" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  rm -rf "$empty_prefix"
  if moonshine-steamos-setup --dry-run --user moonshine-user-that-does-not-exist; then
    echo "setup unexpectedly accepted an invalid user" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

name: moonshine
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.14.5"

package:
  name: moonshine
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/hgaiser/moonshine/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 474922701d2364ab034b7ddfc129974246bf9fbe97854b93938d856c9aa25794

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    - not linux
  script:
    env:
      # LTO is disabled upstream (see the AUR PKGBUILD's !lto option)
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
    content: |
      export LIBCLANG_PATH=${BUILD_PREFIX}/lib
      # bindgen needs clang's builtin headers (stdbool.h etc.)
      export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="-resource-dir=$(${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/clang -print-resource-dir)"
      cargo auditable build --release --locked -p moonshine -p moonshine-wsi
      RELEASE_DIR="target/${CARGO_BUILD_TARGET:+${CARGO_BUILD_TARGET}/}release"
      install -Dm755 ${RELEASE_DIR}/moonshine ${PREFIX}/bin/moonshine
      install -Dm755 ${RELEASE_DIR}/libmoonshine_wsi.so ${PREFIX}/lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so
      # The Vulkan loader resolves relative library_path entries relative to the manifest location
      sed 's|/usr/lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so|../../../lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so|' \
        dist/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json > VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json
      install -Dm644 VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json ${PREFIX}/share/vulkan/implicit_layer.d/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json
      install -Dm755 "${RECIPE_DIR}/moonshine-steamos-setup.sh" ${PREFIX}/bin/moonshine-steamos-setup
      install -Dm755 dist/start-moonshine.sh ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/start-moonshine.sh
      install -Dm644 dist/moonshine@.service ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/moonshine@.service
      install -Dm644 dist/60-moonshine.rules ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/60-moonshine.rules
      install -Dm644 dist/moonshine-modules.conf ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/moonshine-modules.conf
      install -Dm644 dist/moonshine-sysusers.conf ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/moonshine-sysusers.conf
      install -Dm644 dist/50-moonshine-inhibit-sleep.rules ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/50-moonshine-inhibit-sleep.rules
      install -Dm644 dist/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json
      install -Dm644 "${RECIPE_DIR}/moonshine-atomic-update.conf" ${PREFIX}/share/moonshine/moonshine-atomic-update.conf
      cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output ./THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - cargo-auditable
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cmake
    - make
    - pkg-config
    - git
    - clang
    - clangdev
    - libclang
  host:
    # inputtino-sys emits link-lib=c++ unconditionally; --as-needed drops it
    # again at runtime since no libc++ symbols are used
    - libcxx-devel
    - libevdev
    - libopus
    - libdrm
    - libgbm
    - wayland
    - libxkbcommon
  run:
    - bash

tests:
  - script: |
      moonshine --help
      moonshine-steamos-setup --help
      if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
        dry_run_output=$(moonshine-steamos-setup --dry-run --no-enable --no-start --no-linger)
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Prefix: ${CONDA_PREFIX}"
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Wrapper: /opt/moonshine-pixi/start-moonshine.sh"
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Moonshine binary: ${CONDA_PREFIX}/bin/moonshine"
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "WSI library: ${CONDA_PREFIX}/lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so"
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Vulkan manifest: /etc/vulkan/implicit_layer.d/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json"
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Templates: validated and rendered successfully"
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Enable service: false"
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "Start service: false"
        printf '%s\n' "$dry_run_output" | grep -F "sudo was not invoked"
        uninstall_output=$(moonshine-steamos-setup --uninstall --dry-run)
        printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "Stop and disable: moonshine@$(id -un).service"
        printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "Preserve Pixi/Conda prefix: ${CONDA_PREFIX}"
        printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "Preserve standalone installation: /opt/moonshine"
        printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "Lingering: unchanged"
        printf '%s\n' "$uninstall_output" | grep -F "sudo was not invoked"
        if env -u CONDA_PREFIX moonshine-steamos-setup --dry-run --no-enable --no-start --no-linger; then
          echo "setup unexpectedly accepted a missing CONDA_PREFIX" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        empty_prefix=$(mktemp -d)
        if CONDA_PREFIX="$empty_prefix" moonshine-steamos-setup --dry-run --no-enable --no-start --no-linger; then
          echo "setup unexpectedly accepted a prefix with missing assets" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        rm -rf "$empty_prefix"
        if moonshine-steamos-setup --dry-run --user moonshine-user-that-does-not-exist; then
          echo "setup unexpectedly accepted an invalid user" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
      fi
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - moonshine
        - moonshine-steamos-setup
      files:
        exists:
          - lib/moonshine/vulkan-layers/libmoonshine_wsi.so
          - share/vulkan/implicit_layer.d/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json
          - share/moonshine/50-moonshine-inhibit-sleep.rules
          - share/moonshine/60-moonshine.rules
          - share/moonshine/VkLayer_moonshine_wsi.json
          - share/moonshine/moonshine-atomic-update.conf
          - share/moonshine/moonshine-modules.conf
          - share/moonshine/moonshine-sysusers.conf
          - share/moonshine/moonshine@.service
          - share/moonshine/start-moonshine.sh
